name: Mana Bat
description: A mana bat is an arcane variant of it's bestial cousin, rumored to have been created by ambitious mage thousands of years ago. Now considered an invasive species, these creatures are drawn to arcane power and will even become aggressive against those who are wielding conduits or challening spells. These creatures are known for replenishing themselves with arcane energy and being able to take on the composition of other elements in response to being exposed to them.

actions.name: Mana Ray
actions.description: The mana bat shoots a ray of raw energy from it's mouth, dealing arcane damage.

actions.name: Harrying Strikes
actions.description: The mana bat uses it's claws to attack a creature, dealing physical damage. For each mana bat that is adjacent to the target, the attack deals an extra 1d10 damage.

actions.name: Mana Drain
actions.description: The mana bat attempts to latch on to a conduit and drain the energy. Instead of damage, this attack reduces the power within a conduit and restores health equal to the amount drained.

actions.name: Echo
actions.description: In response to taking elemental damage, the mana bat changes it's essence to match that of the specific damage type, becoming immune to that type for the next minute. Additionally, it's Mana Ray Action deals damage equal to this type, but the damage bonus modifier is doubled.

traits.name: Arcane Essence
traits.description: When the mana bat is the target of arcane damage, it instead heals an amount equal to the damage done.
